The "Undefined Team" remainder now only collects active unmatched contributors. The change is one edit in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`, in `getAllTeams()`:

- I added a check on the remainder branch (around line 747). A contributor reaches the remainder only if the latest-commit date is blank or `Contributor.isActive()` is true.
- A blank latest-commit date is treated as active explicitly, so nobody is dropped for missing data.
- Configured teams are untouched: the team-matching loop runs before this check and is unchanged.

The `codeanalyzer` module compiles offline (`mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer compile`). The module has no existing tests for this class, so I did not add or run any test for the new behaviour. Nothing is committed.
